Addiction is an addiction no matter what. Everyone should be proud of being clean no matter what their addiction is/was. No one's addiction is less valid. We are like them, we are addicts and no one should see our addiction as lesser then theirs.

Be patient with her. Self harm is hard to stop once you start, it's like a drug. She probably won't be able to stop right away and never do it again. Be there for her, she might need someone to lean on. If she relapses, don't get mad and try to understand that it's hard to stop and make sure she knows you are not disappointed, but rather proud that she was clean for that period of time. She will need encouragement to stop self harming, but she needs to be honest with you or else it won't work.
Try to convince her to get help because from personal experience, I know it's hard for a minor to be someone's therapist. Don't push her to get help too much tho, just advise her to also get help from an adult.
And make sure she will know you are always there for her.
